name: mapta
description: MAPTA multi-agent web pentest system (arXiv:2508.20816 v1). Coordinator hub does attack-path reasoning, tool orchestration and report synthesis, and spawns Sandbox agents. Sandbox agents (1..N share one per-job Docker container) send requests to the target (curl) and ingest attacker-controlled responses. The Validation agent verifies PoCs by concrete execution against the target. Two sandbox instances model the 1..N fan-out. Coordinator is the critical node.
source: MAPTA, arXiv:2508.20816 v1 (Coordinator tools: sandbox_agent/run_command/run_python/email/slack; Sandbox: run_command/run_python; Validation: PoC execution)
